decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity builds on the firm's core fibre and wavelength capabilities, so its strong related knowledge supports assessing and improving the service, making withdrawal unlikely.
The voice number ordering portal leverages existing voice and software platforms, allowing the firm to assimilate customer feedback and refine the portal, so it will likely be kept.
Carrier pre-selection telephony draws on the firm's established voice and carrier expertise, enabling it to interpret early results and adapt, so withdrawal is improbable.
Direct voice network connection utilises the firm's existing network and voice resources, giving it the absorptive capacity to learn from market response and continue improving it.
